author: lachy3433
description: Web search and any page as LLM-ready Markdown, pruned to your query. 25 free searches a day with no key; $1 per 1,000 after.
name: ContextFetch

tools.name: contextfetch_search
tools.title: ContextFetch web search
tools.description: Search the web and get LLM-ready Markdown. Each result has its title, URL and only the passages relevant to the query (cross-encoder pruned context), so it costs far fewer tokens than raw pages. Use for current events, documentation, APIs, research and fact checking.

num_results.description: Number of results to return (1-25, default 5).

include_domains.description: Only return results from these domains, e.g. ["docs.python.org"].

exclude_domains.description: Never return results from these domains.

time_range.description: Only pages published in the last day, week, month or year.

start_published_date.description: Only pages published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Undated pages are dropped.

end_published_date.description: Only pages published on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

topic.description: news: news sources, recent pages first. finance: SEC filings and finance sites. Default general.

category.description: Focus on one kind of page: company, research paper, news, pdf, github, personal site, linkedin profile, financial report, people.

country.description: Two-letter country code (US, DE): that country's results rank higher.

language.description: Two-letter language code (en, de): results in that language rank higher.

tools.name: contextfetch_extract_url
tools.title: ContextFetch URL to Markdown
tools.description: Fetch a public web page (docs, articles, GitHub files, arXiv papers) as clean Markdown with tables preserved. Pass `query` to get only the passages relevant to it instead of the whole page.

query.description: Optional question or topic; returns only the relevant passages.

tools.name: contextfetch_find_similar
tools.title: ContextFetch find similar pages
tools.description: Find pages similar to a given URL (alternatives, related docs, competing libraries), excluding the source domain. Returns titles, URLs and the most relevant passages as Markdown.

url.description: Public http(s) URL to find similar pages for.

num_results.description: Number of results to return (1-25, default 5).

tools.name: contextfetch_research
tools.title: ContextFetch research (evidence pack)
tools.description: Research a question in one call, server-side: runs up to 5 web searches (sub-queries) concurrently, dedupes the pages by URL, ranks them all against the question with a cross-encoder and returns one Markdown evidence pack with numbered [n] sources and their query-pruned passages, quoted verbatim (no generated text). Costs 1 credit per sub-query. Pass your own `sub_queries` (distinct angles on the question) for better coverage. If omitted they are derived from `query`: the query itself, query + "documentation", and query + "benchmark" when it asks about speed, performance or comparisons, else query + "example" (a suffix the query already contains is skipped).

sub_queries.description: Up to 5 search queries covering different angles of the question. Recommended.

tools.name: contextfetch_deep_research
tools.title: ContextFetch deep research
tools.description: Deep research in one call, no LLM: a deep search of the question, its sub-topics (or your sub_queries) as searches of their own, and the pages its list and index results link to, returned as one cited report: summary, key facts, a section per sub-topic and the sources, every passage quoted verbatim with [n]. Costs 10 credits. For a quick evidence pack use contextfetch_research.

sub_queries.description: Up to 3 search queries covering different angles of the question. Strongly recommended.

num_results_per_query.description: Results per sub-query (1-25, default 5; at most 10 are used).

tools.name: contextfetch_answer
tools.title: ContextFetch extractive answer
tools.description: Answer a question with passages quoted verbatim from the web, never generated: searches, scores every passage of the top pages with a cross-encoder and returns the best ones with [n] citations to their sources. Use it for quick factual lookups; the quotes may not fully answer an open-ended question. Costs 1 credit.

tools.name: contextfetch_crawl
tools.title: ContextFetch site crawl
tools.description: Crawl one website from a start URL and get its pages as Markdown: same-site links only, up to `max_depth` hops (<= 3) and `limit` pages (<= 50), robots.txt obeyed. Pass `query` to rank the pages by relevance and return only their relevant passages. Costs 1 credit per page returned.

max_depth.description: Link hops from the start page (0-3, default 1).

query.description: Optional topic: ranks pages and prunes each to the relevant passages.

include_paths.description: Regexes; only follow links whose path matches one, e.g. ["^/docs/"].

exclude_paths.description: Regexes; never follow links whose path matches one.

tools.name: contextfetch_map
tools.title: ContextFetch site map
tools.description: List a website's URLs without fetching its pages: its sitemaps (from robots.txt, else /sitemap.xml) plus the start page's links, same site only, up to `limit` (<= 5,000). Use it to find the right pages before contextfetch_extract_url or contextfetch_crawl. Costs 1 credit.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the site (any page on it).

include_paths.description: Regexes; only list URLs whose path matches one, e.g. ["^/blog/"].

exclude_paths.description: Regexes; never list URLs whose path matches one.

tools.name: contextfetch_balance
tools.title: ContextFetch balance
tools.description: Show the API key's remaining credits, daily burn rate (7-day average) and auto-reload settings, including the last auto-reload error if a payment failed. Needs CONTEXTFETCH_API_KEY; free. Check it before long jobs.

tools.name: contextfetch_auto_reload
tools.title: ContextFetch auto-reload
tools.description: Turn auto-reload on or off, or change it: when credits drop below `threshold`, the saved card buys `pack` again, up to `monthly_max_usd` per month. Needs CONTEXTFETCH_API_KEY and a card saved at checkout. The monthly cap cannot be raised above $500 here.

enabled.description: true to turn auto-reload on, false to turn it off.

threshold.description: Reload when credits drop below this (100-100,000, default 1,000).

pack.description: Pack to buy: instant $15/15,000, builder $50/60,000, scale $150/200,000.

monthly_max_usd.description: Monthly spending cap in USD (at most 500).

tools.name: contextfetch_get_free_key
tools.title: ContextFetch free API key
tools.description: Get a free ContextFetch API key with 2,500 searches (one per network, no sign-up). This session uses it right away; give it to your user so they can set CONTEXTFETCH_API_KEY to keep it.
